title: Tessa Blanchard vs. Sami Callihan
summary: Tessa Blanchard’s fight with Sami Callihan grows from a personal challenge into a pursuit of Impact’s world championship. An initial defeat becomes the foundation for her eventual title victory.

chapters.title: Callihan wins the first major showdown
chapters.result: Sami Callihan defeats Tessa Blanchard in the main event.
chapters.context: The match establishes Blanchard as a main-event challenger despite the loss, leaving her with unfinished business against Callihan.

chapters.title: Blanchard wins the world title
chapters.result: Tessa defeats Callihan to become Impact world champion.
chapters.context: The rematch reverses their Slammiversary result and makes Blanchard the first woman to hold this championship.
